verdict.rationale: Firebase documents Gemini in Firebase as a natural-language chat interface in the console that answers questions about Firebase products, generates code, helps debug/troubleshoot issues, and explains crashes with root-cause analysis — directly matching the story of asking an AI assistant in the dashboard to write queries, debug errors, and explain the backend. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the assistant's query-writing and debugging accuracy, and more detail on query-writing specifically (most evidence emphasizes crash debugging and general Q&A over ad-hoc query generation).
